messages:
dana: FYI support ticket - projectless keys jittered into project bands and triggered quota alerts for short bursts. Need a guardrail.

rick: yup, saw alerts. Proposal: decouple serving vs billing affinity. Serve to project quickly, but only switch billing after a commit window.

kevin: agree. Implementation: shadow ledger while billing pending; commit if sustained > commit_window. Defaults: commit_window=45s, serving_ttl=10s, cooldown=1h.

maya: console needs to show billing state (pending|committed|reverted) on key detail and a small transition timeline. Support should be able to search billing:pending.

dana: telemetry: add routing.serving_owner, billing.state, billing.shadow_bytes, decision_reason. Index a tiny sample for logs.

rick: safety: cap commits per key (3/24h) and add exponential backoff after reverts. Add a manual override API for admins with audit logs.

ops-bot: Feature-flag gating `billing_affinity_split` created at 1749612370.

kevin: will draft a short RFC + runbook, include billing export changes so finance can reconcile shadow->commit events.

maya: thanks. also add a small analytics job to track per-key commit frequency to tune defaults.
